description.en: Zhao Zi Hui and his elder brother Zhao Zi Yue were born and raised in Harbor City. One day, Zi Yue discovers the existence of an alien species and abruptly leaves their home. A few years later, Zi Hui still can't find peace as his brother's disappearance comes back to haunt him.
description.zh: 浩瀚宇宙，人类这一渺小生物，竟孕育了一股超脱维度并难以解释力量，赵子辉和赵子月本是在海港城市的普通少年兄弟，在意外得知地球并非人类主宰后，哥哥便离家出走，了无音讯。几年后，弟弟赵子辉收到了哥哥的尸体认领通知，可此时脑中却传来了哥哥的声音……

description.en: Since he started high school, Lu Jia has rarely called Mu Wenran “Big Bro”. Exceptions would be whenever he is lying or feeling nervous. Back when he didn’t want to do his homework, he would act sickly and say, “Big Bro, my head hurts” or “I understand everything in this chapter. I really do, Big Bro”. Yet now, 23-year-old Lu Jia will still cry in front of Mu Wenran. While crying, he said, “Sorry, I don’t like you, Big Bro.” He lied. Mu Wenran smiled and wiped Lu Jia’s tears, before saying softly, “It’s alright. I like you.”

description.en:
【Translation provided by the copyright owner.】
When they met for the first time, Qing Ling took off Zhuge Yunle's clothes, wore them and went home happily. And when they met for the second time, Qing Ling took off her own clothes and warned, "Go away, or else I'll scream!" As for the third time, Qing Ling talked to him, "Difficult the first time, easy the second, come on!" Zhuge Yunle had to say that he had never seen such a shameless girl before. But all of a sudden, he fell in love with her, what should he do?

Deep in the palace, lives a girl named Yu Pan. Forbidden by her mother to go even to the outside, Yu Pan entertains herself by learning as many things as possible to be fit to be one of the Prince's mistresses. Because of her eagerness and talent, the emperor invites Yu Pan to study with the Prince. Can she love someone whom she's never even met…?

Because of a song, two completely different fates overlap. We always start to think how much we love each other, but gradually, love loses its initial appearance. Could that be possible, most of the time, what we love most is just ourselves?

Gu Yun returns to his hometown to fulfill his father's last wish, and meets his childhood friend, Lu Yihan, through an assassination attempt by the Lucas family. Despite the endless issues and incidents, Gu Yun developed a strong relationship with Lu Yihan. As they endured hardships together, they grew closer and eventually became close friends.

description.en: This is the story of a boy who suffers from paranoia? Phones, laptops, dogs, … everything he sees appears human. One day, he meets another boy, who shares his fate. And their adventure begins…

A young protagonist who, feeling disconnected from his surroundings, leaps from a high bridge and experiences a transformative journey into an alternate reality. This act serves as a metaphorical gateway, prompting him to question the nature of his existence and the world around him. Throughout the series, the protagonist confronts various challenges that interplay between reality and illusion, compelling him to make choices that define his identity and destiny. The narrative explores themes of self-discovery, the courage to pursue one's convictions despite societal pressures, and the quest for authenticity in a world rife with facades.

Is the unachievable the best thing? Shouldn't the present happiness be treasured the most? A broken vase cannot be fixed, chasing after a past that does not exist will only bring a deeper pain to oneself and others. A vampire's love and hatred will be displayed here, in their fullest…

Three years ago, Ye Tang, who came from a slum but dreamed of becoming a lawyer to change his poor fate, fell in love with Meng Yixing, a young gang leader who approached him wearing a mask. He was exploited by Meng Yixing and fell to the lowest point in his life. Three years later, Ye Tang, who had forged his resume and used someone else's identity to become a lawyer, reunited with Meng Yixing. Meng Yixing, who knew his past, blackmailed him to continue their relationship. This time, Ye Tang decided to turn the tables and exploit Meng Yixing. The two con artists deceived each other until there was nothing left, then exploited one another.
description.id: Tiga tahun yang lalu, Ye Tang, yang berasal dari pemukiman kumuh namun bermimpi menjadi pengacara untuk mengubah nasib miskinnya, jatuh cinta pada Meng Yixing, pemimpin muda geng yang mendekatinya dengan topeng. Dia dimanfaatkan oleh Meng Yixing dan terjatuh ke titik terendah dalam hidupnya. Tiga tahun kemudian, Ye Tang, yang memalsukan riwayat hidup dan menggunakan identitas orang lain untuk menjadi pengacara, bertemu kembali dengan Meng Yixing. Meng Yixing, yang mengetahui masa lalunya, memerasnya untuk melanjutkan hubungan mereka. Kali ini, Ye Tang memutuskan untuk membalikkan keadaan dan memanfaatkan Meng Yixing. Kedua penipu itu saling menipu hingga tak tersisa apa-apa, lalu memanfaatkan satu sama lain.

From The Hundred Schools of Thought, comes warlords vying for supremacy; the hegemony returns. In order to avoid the murderous pursuit of the Gongshu family's mechanical beasts, Tianming, Shaoyu, and Shi Lan boarded the "Mirage" anchored by the sea. The out of reach mysterious great warship was for the first time before these three in close range - under its magnificent outward appearance, exactly what kind of secrets are hiding? Between the Vertical Alliance and the Horizontal Alliance, instability rises again….

Betrayed by her family five years ago, she lost her loved ones and her lover. But a genius baby was left with her. She vowed to revive her life, but didn't expect to meet the fateful man, Huo Tingchen. 

"We don't know each other!" 
"You stole my seed and wanna run away?" 
"I stole your what?" 

Alas, her son is just a mini-version of this man, only cuter and smarter.

Just when he was forced to desperate by the creditor, he accidentally scanned a mysterious QR code. Didn't expect to add the gods in the sky as friends in the circle of friends? ! Not only did the God of Wealth Zhao Gongming teach him to get rich, but also Yue Lao helped him solve the object problem. His life has been smooth from then on…

This story is about an outer god, chaos, whispers, an abyss... as well as annoying complications causing a state of turmoil and certain demands… Ahem, shhhh~ Due to heavy debts, Chaohai is pulled into an entanglement he cannot escape. A debt-ridden college student x a natural-born demon disciple of an outer god.
If you plant your yard full of red spider lilies, you can deceive spirits into believing it to be one of the many roads to the afterlife, and perhaps, meet the deceased dear to you…
The crown prince of dragon clan from the deep blue sea comes to the human world to look for his bride. But he doesn't know that his bride is a twin…

Day 4: Hello, make sure to drink more warm water. Gu Yi Le could no longer hold back, and asked online: Is this guy using me as a punch clock? A week later, he thought of sharing photos with each other to see whether they’re a good match.

Simultaneously, the plants and animals on the planet are also evolving toward their ancestry line or developing spiritual mutations.

Lin Yuan realizes that he can assist feys in evolving limitlessly and constantly purify their bloodlines. He starts off with a small fey evolution store on the Star Web and rises up from there.

Lin Yuan: “There is no problem that I cannot solve to deliver the goods. If there is a problem, it is because the goods are better than expectations!”

Sheng Xian said, “Your birthday.” Lu Jingyan was sure that Sheng Xian had a crush on her since he was using her birthday as the password to his hotspot, hence she started openly and inadvertently flirting with Sheng Xian. Half a year later, she found out by chance that Sheng Xian’s wifi password was…

description.en:
Once emotions arise, they cannot be stopped.

Sisters x love x technology curiosity x crazy x robots

The winner of the Golden Comic Newcomer Award: Wu Yushi;
with his delicate and unique classical and gorgeous atmosphere,
A cool and beautiful dystopian fable.

The relationship between robots and humans, as sisters, is on the edge of fragmentation:
Christmas is coming,
Joe Dr. Milburn brings a gift to his daughter Lily - "Robot No. A-00".
Lily, who is lively and kind but often feels lonely, name this special friend "Shirley".
This is how she welcomed an important companion in her life who is like a sister.

When Shirley began to possess the magic stone "heart", complex and contradictory emotions, a broken body, the opposite sex that she care about...
What will gradually sprout from the cold machine body?
How should "it" become the real "her"?
___
The busy doctor mother prepares a robot as a companion for her daughter.
However, can the connection and intimacy between mother and daughter be replaced by a robot? 

When the daughter and the robot became sisters, why did they go from talking about everything to being suspicious of each other?

"If I had spoken out clearly at the beginning, would the ending not be what it is now?"

情感一旦滋生，即無法停止

description.en: Nanfeng and Ya were a team of paranormal investigators with different personalities. Nanfeng loved to investigate various haunted places while Ya prefered to observe the world quietly. They gained some local fame for solving a paranormal case. However, more incidents occurred and their true identities became even more obscured. It was as though someone was drawing them from the school to the city. More and more people were being implicated, and they were being drawn into an even greater whirlwind of chaos.

"Continue being the warrior king." 
"No." 
"There will be salary increase and promotion." 
"No."
